biothings.name: Crohn disease, non-human animal
biothings.definition: Crohn disease that occurs in non-human animals. [MONDO:patterns/nonhuman_disease]

biothings.name: inflammatory bowel disease 30
biothings.definition: An inflammatory bowel disease characterized by abdominal pain and watery or bloody diarrhea, with changes in the intestinal tract consistent with Crohn disease that has material basis in heterozygous mutation in the CARD8 gene on chromosome 19q13.33. [DOID:0112154]

biothings.name: perianal Crohn disease
biothings.definition: A Crohn disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the anal region. [MONDO:patterns/specific_inflammatory_disease_by_site]

biothings.name: inflammatory bowel disease 1
biothings.definition: Any inflammatory bowel disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the NOD2 gene. [MONDO:patterns/disease_series_by_gene]
biothings.synonyms: Crohn disease-associated growth failure, IBD1, inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn disease) 1, inflammatory bowel disease 1, inflammatory bowel disease 1, Crohn disease, inflammatory bowel disease caused by mutation in NOD2, inflammatory bowel disease type 1, NOD2 inflammatory bowel disease

opentargets.name: Crohn disease
opentargets.description: A gastrointestinal disorder characterized by chronic inflammation involving all layers of the intestinal wall, noncaseating granulomas affecting the intestinal wall and regional lymph nodes, and transmural fibrosis. Crohn disease most commonly involves the terminal ileum; the colon is the second most common site of involvement.

opentargets.name: small bowel Crohn disease
opentargets.description: A Crohn disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the small intestine.

opentargets.name: perianal Crohn disease
opentargets.description: A Crohn disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the anal region.

opentargets.name: gastroduodenal Crohn disease
opentargets.description: An inflammatory bowel disease characterized by inflammation located in stomach and located in duodenum, has symptom nausea, has symptom vomiting, has symptom weight loss and has symptom loss of appetite.

opentargets.name: inflammatory bowel disease
opentargets.description: A spectrum of small and large bowel inflammatory diseases of unknown etiology. It includes Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, and colitis of indeterminate type.
